newsitem.title: USA: ERD Waste to close New York facility.
newsitem.headline: ERD Waste to close New York facility.

text.p: ERD Waste Corp said on Tuesday it will permanently cease operations of its Long Beach, N.Y., facility under a consent order it entered with state regulators.

The consent order with the Attorney General and the Department of Environmental Conservation provides that the company will stop using the facility as an incinerator and a solid waste transfer station, effective April 14, 1997, ERD said.
ERD Waste said the consent order also defines the obligations of the company with respect to the closure of the site, but the company presently does not expect the cost to be material.

Upon completion and approval of the implementation of the closure plan, the state will not sue the company for any investigation or remediation of site conditions addressed by the closure plan, the company said.

ERD said it previously reported a write-down of the value of the Long Beach facility assets and recorded a net loss of $7,167,998 in its Annual Report on Form 10-KSB for the fiscal year ended September 30, 1996 to reflect the discontinuation of those operations.
The consent order does not resolve any of the claims between the company and the City of Long Beach, ERD said.
